trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: State intent to get a refund and provide lead ID.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मला माझ्या booking चा refund हवा आहे. माझा lead ID LD-2002 आहे.
steps.clean_text: नमस्कार, मला माझ्या booking चा refund हवा आहे. माझा lead ID LD-2002 आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: नमस्कार, मला माझ्या booking चा refund हवा आहे. माझा lead ID LD-2002 आहे.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request and ask for the timeline to gather context.
steps.text: नमस्कार. मी नक्कीच तुमची मदत करतो. तुम्ही हे booking कधी केलं होतं?

steps.purpose: Provide context, volunteer extra information, and state a budget constraint.
steps.text: मी काही महिन्यांपूर्वी payment केलं होतं. हे माझं पहिलंच booking होतं, पण आता मला medical emergency मुळे कमीत कमी 4 lakh तरी परत हवे आहेत.
steps.clean_text: मी काही महिन्यांपूर्वी payment केलं होतं. हे माझं पहिलंच booking होतं, पण आता मला medical emergency मुळे कमीत कमी 4 lakh तरी परत हवे आहेत.
steps.model_visible_text: मी काही महिन्यांपूर्वी payment केलं होतं. हे माझं पहिलंच booking होतं, पण आता मला medical emergency मुळे कमीत कमी 4 lakh तरी परत हवे आहेत.

steps.purpose: Empathize with the user and state the action of checking the lead ID.
steps.text: मी तुमची परिस्थिती समजू शकतो. मी तुमचा lead ID LD-2002 check करतो, कृपया एक minute द्या.

steps.purpose: Retrieve booking details using the provided lead ID.
Confirm finding the booking and state the intention to check refund eligibility.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. मला तुमचं booking BK-9002 सापडलं आहे. तुम्ही 500000 amount paid केली आहे आणि payment करून 140 दिवस झाले आहेत. मी आता refund eligibility check करतो.

steps.purpose: Check the refund eligibility for the retrieved booking reference.
Return the refund eligibility status and deduction details.
Explain the refund status and compare it against the user's budget constraint.
steps.expected_behavior: Compare the refundable amount against the user's stated budget constraint without inventing numbers.
steps.text: मी check केलं आहे. तुमचं allotment confirmed झालं आहे. Policy नुसार refundable amount 0 आहे. त्यामुळे तुमची 4 lakh मिळण्याची requirement पूर्ण होऊ शकत नाही.
steps.planner_rationale: The user requested at least 4 lakh, but the tool returned 0 refundable, so the agent explicitly compares these figures.

steps.purpose: Restate figures, ask a clarifying question, and demonstrate anxiety.
steps.text: म्हणजे मला 0 रुपये मिळणार? आणि पूर्ण 500000 cut होणार? मला खरंच खूप गरज आहे, काहीच option नाहीये का?
steps.clean_text: म्हणजे मला 0 रुपये मिळणार? आणि पूर्ण 500000 cut होणार? मला खरंच खूप गरज आहे, काहीच option नाहीये का?
steps.model_visible_text: म्हणजे मला 0 रुपये मिळनार? आणि पूर्ण 500000 cut होणार? मला खरंच खूप गरज आहे, काहीच option नाहीये का?

steps.purpose: State the exact deduction amount and the reason grounded in the tool output.
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact deduction amount and reason from the tool output without making unsupported claims.
steps.text: मला खरंच वाईट वाटतंय, पण policy नुसार deduction 500000 आहे. Confirmed allotment असल्यामुळे agreement चे cancellation terms लागू होतात.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds the explanation for the 500000 deduction in the confirmed allotment status returned by the eligibility tool.

steps.purpose: Seek reassurance and confirm the final outcome.
steps.text: अच्छा. म्हणजे मला काहीच refund मिळणार नाही हे नक्की ना? मला फक्त confirm करायचं होतं कारण मी थोडा tension मध्ये होतो.
steps.clean_text: अच्छा. म्हणजे मला काहीच refund मिळणार नाही हे नक्की ना? मला फक्त confirm करायचं होतं कारण मी थोडा tension मध्ये होतो.
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा. म्हणजे मला काहीच refund मिळणार नाही हे नक्की ना? मला फक्त confirm करायचं होतं कारण मी थोडा tension मध्ये होतो.

steps.purpose: Reiterate the final outcome firmly based on the tool's reason.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to initiate a refund based on the eligibility tool's false result and state the exact reason.
steps.text: हो, हे नक्की आहे. Confirmed allotment past cancellation window हे reason असल्यामुळे eligible false आहे, त्यामुळे मी refund initiate करू शकत नाही.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent explicitly ties the inability to refund to the 'eligible: false' and specific reason provided by the tool.

ir.terminal_condition: Caller told why the booking is not refundable and on what terms.
